description: This file implements contact management functionality for an Android app, including searching and adding contacts via the device contacts provider, with permission handling and JSON-based request/response processing.

classes.name: ContactRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a contact's details including identifier, display name, name components, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating search query parameters such as the search string and result limit.

classes.name: ContactsAddRequest
classes.description: Data class holding contact creation details including optional name, organization, and lists of phone numbers and emails.

classes.name: ContactsDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for contact data operations: permission checks, search, and add.

classes.name: SystemContactsDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing ContactsDataSource to interact with Android's contacts provider.

classes.name: ContactsHandler
classes.description: Main class handling contact search and add requests, managing permissions, and interfacing with data source.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read contacts.

methods.name: hasWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to modify contacts.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs contact search based on query and limit, querying the contacts content provider.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact to the device contacts provider based on provided details.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch
methods.description: Processes JSON request to search contacts, returning results or errors.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd
methods.description: Processes JSON request to add a contact, returning the created contact or errors.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a ContactsSearchRequest object.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a ContactsAddRequest object.

methods.name: contactJson
methods.description: Converts a ContactRecord into a JSON object for external use.
